changes.en: About half the amount. Dried herb has the stronger flavour and goes in at the start of cooking, because its flavour takes longer to develop.
changes.de: Etwa die halbe Menge. Getrocknetes Kraut schmeckt kräftiger und kommt zu Beginn des Kochens hinein, weil sich sein Aroma langsamer entfaltet.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Conversely, if a recipe calls for a certain amount of fresh herb, you would use about one-half of that amount of dry herb.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Herbs are available fresh or dried, with fresh herbs having a more subtle flavour than dried.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.sentence: Dried herbs are usually added at the start of the cooking process as their flavour takes longer to develop than fresh herbs.
